parameters.name: cognitoDomainPrefix
parameters.description: Amazon Cognito hosted UI domain prefix (must be unique).

parameters.name: cognitoCallbackUrls
parameters.description: Callback URLs for Cognito auth (e.g. https://localhost:5173).

parameters.name: transcribeRegion
parameters.description: Amazon Transcribe region for fallback STT.

parameters.name: translateRegion
parameters.description: Amazon Translate region for fallback MT.

parameters.name: translateProxyEnabled
parameters.description: Proxy Translate requests through CloudFront to avoid CORS.

parameters.name: pollyRegion
parameters.description: Amazon Polly region for fallback TTS.

parameters.name: pollyProxyEnabled
parameters.description: Proxy Polly requests through CloudFront to avoid CORS.
